text: The retrieved evidence (PMID 22963769, on desmosomal/hemidesmosomal protein localization in oral squamous cell carcinoma) is irrelevant to bacterial membrane purity, so the claim cannot be confirmed from it; mechanistically, however, it is plausible, since OmpF is an outer-membrane porin and stronger OmpF spots in a cytoplasmic (inner) membrane fraction from overexpressors would indicate outer-membrane contamination, i.e., reduced purity.
